cases.purpose: Check child signal and ordinary exit statuses while the invoking shell survives
cases.oracle: POSIX wait status mapping 128 plus signal number and exact ordinary child exit status; compare locked util-linux reference.
cases.comparison: Capture shell-generated diagnostics in a grouped redirection; assert the actual statuses independently of diagnostic text.
cases.script:
{ prlimit --nofile=64:64 /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os,signal;os.kill(os.getpid(),signal.SIGTERM)'; term=$?; } 2> term.err
{ prlimit --nofile=64:64 /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os,signal;os.kill(os.getpid(),signal.SIGKILL)'; killed=$?; } 2> kill.err
{ prlimit --nofile=64:64 /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys;sys.exit(143)'; exited=$?; } 2> exit.err
printf 'term=%s kill=%s exit=%s shell=alive\n' "$term" "$killed" "$exited"
